purpose: EXACT restore target for pmus-readonly-recovery, captured BEFORE any change, so restoration is verifiable rather than remembered.
NOTE_ON_VARIABLE_VALUES: Variable VALUES are redacted to this session (names only). No value is read, printed or rewritten. RAILWAY_DOCKERFILE_PATH is the only variable this operation touches; it is restored to the value that config.build.dockerfilePath attests, which is the authoritative field.
NOTE_ON_SOURCE: source carries no commitSha, so the service follows the branch head rather than a pinned commit. Restoration therefore restores the BRANCH, which is the same binding it had.
